turns.text: That's wonderful to hear. How are things going with leading the science department this term? Is the new school year keeping you on your toes?

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Grace sounds like an amazing partner. It makes such a difference having that support. Are the two of you planning a quiet evening to wind down before Monday?

turns.text: Yes, absolutely. We're going to keep it very low-key. We plan on putting on some old sitcom reruns to laugh at while we lounge on the couch.
